title: python3 test failures

labels.name: Testing
labels.description: pandas testing functions or related to the test suite

body:
on ubuntu 13.04 several tests fail with 3.3 while they suceed with python2
13.04 has python 3.3 and numpy 1.7
current pandas head 61766ec5f898c89
